decisions.reason: A classic lever handle sits squarely within the firm's core design and ergonomics knowledge, so it can read early market feedback and refine the product at low risk.
A handle family extends the firm's system breadth and builds directly on its established fittings know-how, which favours continued assimilation and commercial use.
A new handle design close to the existing portfolio uses the firm's design competence and certified systems, and one year is too early to justify withdrawal.
Strong related knowledge lets the firm interpret results and adapt this design rather than drop it after only one year on the market.
Lever handle families are a core competence and fit the strategic push toward broader integrated system families.

The L700 electronic access system builds on in-house R&D and fits the strategic move toward digital building organization, where its distinctive light technology supports learning and further development.
